record.question: The operational goals of Family Welfare programme are all EXCEPT
options: To promote the adoption of small family size norm on the basis of voluntary acceptance
To promote the use of spacing methods
To promote delayed marriage for girls not earlier than 18 and preferably after 20 years of age
To arrange for clinical and surgical services so as to achieve the set targets
record.explanation: Achieving set targets is not a voluntary family welfare goal.
